## Complete Type III closure across every original owner and both loads

The [full owner/load assembly](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/02d0c4e21adb03ab35cbdd2327e1b489a9d7a3b0/research/nine/D02_BOTH_UNLOADED_HUBS_UNIQUE_CIRCLE_TYPE_III_ALL_ORIGINAL_OWNER_ROWS_COMPLETE_EXCLUSION_2026_10_29.md) exhausts all six original AD owner alternatives. Both perpendicular owners are impossible. Complete actual-point projection arguments exclude the entire genuine and shared A rows. The remaining genuine and shared D rows have complete exits in both original load columns.

A [radius-free return-support theorem](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/02d0c4e21adb03ab35cbdd2327e1b489a9d7a3b0/research/nine/VERTICALLY_SEPARATED_RETURN_SUPPORTS_NO_UNLOADED_TRUE_TWO_BRIDGE_AND_SHARED_D_L135_EXCLUSION_2026_10_29.md) excludes an unloaded true2 bridge between the stated vertically separated supports. It retains arbitrary exterior-unit degrees, loads, support owners and full means. The exact actual D frames place both D-owner rows in this theorem, removing their whole L135 column at once.

For loaded N, whole-unit support geometry and the complete separating-axis argument force physical circle clearance. The genuine-D middle domain has center squared norm below `16081/9800<81/49`, with exact reserve `119/9800`. The full low/middle/high ratio join and shared-D outer/middle angle join cover all remaining parameters. No unloaded equation is assigned to loaded N.

The package contains eleven complete mathematical sources, eight separate component reviews, four explicitly labeled contributor confirmations and two full independent root reviews. Root read every source and review, independently reconstructed the final genuine-D middle proof and the complete assembly, verified all sixteen direct assembly pins, and corroborated fourteen exact rational signs plus the polynomial identities. The immutable tree changes exactly 33 allowlisted paths, with every expected Git blob verified and no deletions.

- The entire house ADT three-genuine-root family.
- The entire fan H12/H34 three-genuine-root orbit.
- Every private parallel return path with one, two or three internal true2 units.
- The literal rim 01,12,23,34,45,50 with chord02 and genuine leaves at 0,1,2.

These results join the full nonparallel, both-outer-owned, large-tilt and all-middle-slider small-chart cases. The full house degrees A4/D4/T3/B2/C2 and fan degrees H5/1_3/2_4/3_3/4_2 remain. All physical completion units and force/mean alternatives remain. ## Precise remaining scope

The remaining five-body three-distinct-genuine-root families include house ADB, house ABC and fan H23. Other graph and attachment-forest obligations remain in the original ledger.

The common initial owner-selection domain and diagonal avoidance remain explicitly conditional earlier inputs. These new proofs do not establish the missing global compatibility audit or alter an extracted certificate. Every argument retains all nine actual squares, original positive forces, true degrees, actual selected normals, full shared means, physical circle masks and individually zero circle coefficients.

Hand proofs only. No Lean/Lake build, CI/workflow dispatch, numerical pose search, angle mesh, new packing certificate or merge.

The complete preceding PR description, including earlier accepted results and immutable links, is preserved in the [archive at 327c9a5](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/02d0c4e21adb03ab35cbdd2327e1b489a9d7a3b0/research/nine/PR11_DESCRIPTION_ARCHIVE_AT_327C9A5_2026_10_29.json).
